name: seedling-not-seed
note: h008: seedling (চারা) must not become বীজ (seed)

name: spore-not-seed
note: h018: spore (রেণু) must not become বীজ (seed)

name: toxicity-not-disparity
note: h005: toxicity (বিষাক্ততা) must not become বিষমতা (disparity)

name: stunting-not-translit
note: h016: stunting should be translated, not transliterated to স্টান্টিং

name: broadcast-not-tvbroadcast
note: h028: broadcast seeding (ছিটিয়ে বপন) must not become সম্প্রচার (TV broadcast)
